color.label: Color
color.note: the word being said takes the accent color and hands it on

pop.label: Pop
pop.note: the word swells and the line makes room for it, in the text's own color unless an accent is set

underline.label: Underline
underline.note: accent color with a rule under the word

box.label: Highlight
box.note: an accent box behind the word

spotlight.label: Spotlight
spotlight.note: the line sits faded and only the word being said is at full strength

build.label: Build up
build.note: the line starts empty and each word appears as it is said, completing the sentence

fill.label: Fill in
fill.note: the whole line is up but faint, and each word goes solid as it is said until the sentence is fully opaque

rise.label: Rise up
rise.note: each word lifts into its place as it is said and stays

bloom.label: Bloom
bloom.note: each word grows out of nothing into its size as it is said and stays

swing.label: Swing in
swing.note: each word drops in leaning and rights itself as it is said

paint.label: Paint on
paint.note: the line is written in its own color and each word takes the accent as it is said, keeping it
